description: This is a PHP unit test class 'DownloadFormatTest' that tests the functionalities of 'JsonDownloadFormat' related to download filenames, within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin.

classes.name: DownloadFormatTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class to verify the behavior of JsonDownloadFormat's filename generation methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by instantiating JsonDownloadFormat and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testDownloadFileName
methods.description: Tests that the download filename generated for specific IDs matches expected filenames.
